test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No.2.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3' **i.e. **'Resumed'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the given passage,** it is **mentioned that** the Games were held every four years from 1924 until 1936, after which they were (blank No. 1) by World War II.
 
• The Olympics (blank No. 2) in 1948 and was (blank No. 3) held every four years.
 
• The word **"resumed" **best **fits the context **as it means to begin again after an interruption or pause.
 
• After the interruption caused by World War II, the Olympics **resumed **in 1948.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is : *The Olympics** resumed** in 1948 *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) "confirmed"** means to establish the truth or correctness of something. It does not align with the context of the sentence, which refers to the resumption of the Olympics after World War II.
 
• **Option 2) "transformed" **means to change in form or appearance. It does not accurately convey the idea of the Olympics starting again after a pause.
 
• **Option 4) "accustomed"** means to become familiar with something through repeated experience. It does not make sense in this context as it does not reflect the resumption of the Olympics.
